$comment: Shubhvela design tokens (round 2, moved from the design mocks in A05). Single source for app/src/theme/tokens.ts, web/src/tokens.css and ui/token-contrast.json, all written by packages/content/scripts/gen-tokens.ts (never edit those outputs by hand). Colours are sRGB hex; contrast ratios are computed by the generator and asserted by test/tokens.test.ts. Review fixes applied here: N7 (type.scale.micro.note no longer lists inline band labels, which are caption 13 / weight 600), M6 (size.bannerStrip removed; the strip is the measured banner height + 2 x bannerPadding, so bottomPaddingAboveBanner is a formula, not 82).

ink.use: primary text, chart lines, now-marker line

ink-3.use: captions, tick labels, table headers, chart sign numerals

hair-2.use: control borders, switch track, band hairlines

accent.use: primary buttons, Why?, active tab, now-marker time label, selected states

accent-tint.use: selected chip fill, current dasha cell

good.use: favourable span fill in the good-hours band (saffron), always with the dot pattern

good-ink.use: inline label and dot pattern on good

neutral.use: neutral span fill (day), lane background, disabled fills

avoid.use: inauspicious span fill, always with the hatch pattern

avoid-hatch.use: hatch stroke on avoid (>=3:1 against avoid)

night.use: neutral span fill after sunset (deep indigo); night legend swatch

indigo.use: approx. tag text/outline, approximate glyphs, focus ring

indigo-tint.use: flag fill, night hora cells in the expanded list

label.note: buttons, chips, the Now line, table cells (400 for secondary lines)

caption.note: footers, legends, sunrise line, how this was computed, inline band labels (600)

micro.note: floor; tags, tick labels, tab labels, table headers, chart sign numerals, dasha strip labels

chart.note: user units at viewBox 320; scaled by fontScale / (renderedWidth/320), see design.md 4

size.bottomPaddingAboveBanner: tabBar + (measuredBannerHeight + 2 * bannerPadding, when AdPolicy shows a banner) + 16 + safeAreaBottom
